entities.summary: Andy Souwer is a Dutch former kickboxer and mixed martial artist of Cypriot origins He is a two-time K-1 World MAX champion and four-time Shootboxing World tournament champion as well as former It's Showtime 70MAX world champion, fighting out of Mejiro Gym in Amsterdam.
